nodes.speaker: Kit
nodes.text: <shake>Hey! New face!</shake>

nodes.speaker: Kit
nodes.text: Over here! You look about as lost as I was on my first day.

nodes.speaker: {player}
nodes.text: Another stranger shouting at me. At least this one's smiling.

nodes.speaker: Kit
nodes.text: I'm Kit. Welcome to Lumenfall Academy! Let me give you the lay of the land before you walk into a wall.

nodes.speaker: Kit
nodes.text: Up ahead is the courtyard. The fountain sits right in the middle of it, so if you ever get lost, head back there.

nodes.speaker: Kit
nodes.text: The grand one is the Main Academy Building: reception, the main portal and most of the staff. Every building has a sign by its door.

nodes.speaker: Kit
nodes.text: The Arcane Workshop is where the engineering lot tinker with relics and machines. Mind the sparks.

nodes.speaker: Kit
nodes.text: The Training Centre is for spell practice, and the Library is for studying. Or napping between the shelves. I won't tell.

nodes.speaker: Kit
nodes.text: And back through the gate is the forest. Lovely in the daytime. A bit dramatic after dark.

nodes.speaker: {player}
nodes.text: Spell practice. Relics. So the afterlife is a magic school. Sure. Why not.

nodes.speaker: Kit
nodes.text: Oh! You missed the orientation ceremony, by the way. It finished a little while ago.

nodes.speaker: Kit
nodes.text: But Professor Bann, the headmistress, is still by the fountain in the middle of the courtyard. Go and speak to her right away.

nodes.speaker: Kit
nodes.text: Seriously, go now. She's lovely, but she does not like waiting.

nodes.speaker: {player}
nodes.text: The headmistress. By the fountain. Right.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Bann
nodes.text: Ah, there you are. You must be {player}, our latecomer. Professor Kepler mentioned you.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Bann
nodes.text: I'm Professor Bann, headmistress of Lumenfall. I'm afraid you've missed orientation entirely.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Bann
nodes.text: Not to worry. I'll organise a student guide to go over all of it with you tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Bann
nodes.text: For now, report to your dorm and get your room sorted.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Bann
nodes.text: Today is meant for exploring and speaking to your fellow students. I suggest you get your room done first, then do whatever else you please.

nodes.speaker: {player}
nodes.text: A headmistress, a dorm room and a free day. For the afterlife, this is weirdly organised.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Bann
nodes.text: Off you go, then. Welcome to Lumenfall, {player}.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Bann
nodes.text: Your dorm first, {player}. Get your room sorted, and then the rest of the day is yours.

events.description: Once the player has heard Prof. Bann out, talking to her again gives the short reminder instead.
